title: 10 Things a Godly Man's Phone Steals After 10 PM
caption:
Screen time never shows you the real cost.

It's not just minutes. It's the last clear thought before sleep, the prayer you meant to pray, the conversation you were physically present for and mentally absent from. Ten years of that adds up to a decade spent somewhere other than present.

What time does your phone actually go down tonight?

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #digitaldetox
